structured_fields.tag: Because eggs are great any time of the day.
structured_fields.description:
Made with the freshest, warm, off-the-farm egg; steamed to perfection in our specialised steamer; and made tasty with a sprinkling of magic masala. Sandwiched between freshly toasted buns, topped off with
                                creamy mayo and some crunchy onion.

categorical_fields.allergy: Cereal containing gluten, Milk, Egg, Soya
